skill.summary: Scrapes healthcare providers and patient signals by niche and location, scores leads, extracts contacts, and generates personalized outreach and promo videos.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial public release of the Healthcare & Wellness Lead Generator skill.
- Automates healthcare lead generation by scraping clinics, practitioners, wellness businesses, and active patient signals from multiple online sources.
- Provides reputation gap analysis, contact details extraction, and AI-based lead scoring and prioritization.
- Generates personalized, HIPAA-mindful outreach messages and ready-to-use promotional videos for each lead using InVideo AI and Claude AI.
- Designed for sales reps, clinics, wellness brands, and telehealth platforms to easily find and contact high-conversion prospects in any location.
